title: Homotopy-commuting invariance of path-model pullbacks
statement:
Use simplicial sets, spaces, Kan complexes and weak homotopy equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Work in its fixed containing universe. Let $u:U\to W$, $v:V\to W$, $u':U'\to W'$, and $v':V'\to W'$ be maps of Kan complexes. Let $a:U\to U'$, $b:V\to V'$, and $c:W\to W'$ be weak homotopy equivalences. Suppose specified simplicial homotopies are given from $c\circ u$ to $u'\circ a$ and from $c\circ v$ to $v'\circ b$. Write
$$P(u,v)=U\times_{W,\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,W)\times_{W,\operatorname{ev}_1}V,$$
with paths directed from $u(x)$ to $v(y)$, and define $P(u',v')$ similarly. There exists a simplicial comparison sending $(x,y,\gamma)$ to $(a(x),b(y),H_u(x)^{-1}*c(\gamma)*H_v(y))$, where $H_u,H_v$ are the specified homotopies and $*$ is coherent path concatenation, which is a weak homotopy equivalence. Coherent concatenation means choosing composition triangles in the Kan complex, simultaneously on the whole parameter simplicial set; any such coherent choice gives the same comparison up to homotopy. The construction retains all parameter simplices and further homotopies of the displayed data.

source.place: Agent-formulated homotopy-commuting extension of Kerodon Proposition 3.4.0.9 (032B), using the path model of Construction 3.4.0.3 (010B), the fiber criterion of Proposition 3.3.7.1 (00ZN), and coherent composition of Subsection 4.6.8 (01PF). Proposition 032B itself assumes strict commutation; the specified endpoint homotopies and simultaneous coherent choices are the additional assertion of this node.
